fills.researcher_notes: Searched 'Phool Nagar' + 'Dawood Hercules' + SNGPL/pipeline/loopline. Results surface both GEM's own rows for this corridor (this Loopline row, and a separate non-loop 'Phool Nagar-Dawood Hercules Gas Pipeline' row that is not in my brief) plus a marketscreener.com article about SNGPL supplying gas to fertiliser plants including Dawood Hercules -- but that article is about supply/curtailment volumes, not pipeline construction, and marketscreener returned 403 to automated fetch so I could not read past the search snippet regardless. Dawood Hercules Chemicals' fertiliser plant itself dates to the late 1960s, but a plant's in-service date is not this pipeline's commissioning date (same caution as the protocol gives for gas-field dates), and 'loopline' in the name implies this is a capacity-addition parallel line built later than the original connection, not at the plant's founding -- so I did not use the plant date as a proxy. No source found that dates the loopline itself. Leaving StartYear1 blank.

validity.researcher_notes: SNGPL Annual Report 2018 asset register (pages 32-35, https://www.sngpl.com.pk/download/AnnualReport-2018/SNGPLAR-2018.pdf) lists row 146 'PHOOLNAGAR - DAWOOD HERCULES / 24in / loopline 65.47 km' -- an EXACT match to this row's Diameter and LengthKnown -- alongside a SEPARATE row 145 'PHOOL NAGAR - DAWOOD HERCULES / 16in / mainline 62.38 km', confirming the sibling non-loop pipeline this researcher's search also surfaced is a real, distinct 16in mainline asset, not the same pipe double-counted. This loopline (24in) sits in the same Head Balloki/Phool Nagar table cluster as row 147, which the register EXPLICITLY tags '(RLNG LINE)' (2015-2017 RLNG-import augmentation era, per SNGPL's own milestone timeline naming Bhikki/Balloki/Haveli Bahadur Shah/Nandipur as the served plants) -- and this loopline's 24in diameter matches the '30/24 dia' spec SNGPL's timeline gives for that specific augmentation phase, more so than P4141's 18in (see that row's note). Still not citable as a dated fact for THIS segment specifically -- flagging the RLNG-era hypothesis for a human to chase via OGRA/EPC records, not filling StartYear1 off it.
